financings_after_balance_sheet.what: February 2026 private placement of 2.6 Units (common stock plus warrants); gross proceeds used because net was not given, and the exact closing day is not stated
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: During February 2026, the Company sold and additional 2.6 Units to eight investors for an aggregate purchase price of $650,000.

warrants.quote: the Company issued 162,500 shares of common stock and 162,500 warrants to purchase shares of common stock.
